description: Tabs: list/new/close/switch/window. Yours are grouped and capped. switch = default; add show:true. new never steals the view unless show:true. window = hide/show.

op.description: list = every tab; new = open; close = close; switch = default; window = hide/show.

show.description: new: bring it to the front (default: background); switch: same (default: false).

tab.description: close / switch: the target tab id; omit → session default.

url.description: new: open at this URL (default about:blank).

name: browse_tabs
title: Tabs
